name: Ellery Bops
description: The Ellery Bops were a 1950s–1960s street gang based in the Williamsburg and Bedford-Stuyvesant border area of Brooklyn, centered around Ellery Street. They were allied with the Halsey Bops of Bushwick and operated near the Marcy and Sumner Projects alongside gangs such as the Buccaneers, Jesters, and Latin Kings. In August 1956, member Jose Santiago (15) was stabbed to death by the rival Royal Counts. Their graffiti tag 'LAMF' (Like a Motherf***er) appeared on walls in the Williamsburg area. The gang faded by the mid-1960s.
